titulo: Ukraine live: Zelensky adviser says Starlink restrictions ‘depriving’ Ukraine of defence
cuerpo: An adviser to Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Wednesday that unannounced restrictions to the Starlink satellite system were “depriving” Ukraine of its means of defence. Ukraine uses the network owned by tech magnate Elon Musk to conduct battlefield operations, including drone flights. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
